title: Nvidia server partners reportedly suspend shipments to Southeast Asia following new US export rules
html:
Some suppliers of Nvidia servers are reportedly suspending shipments to Southeast Asia. The chipmaker's stricter end-customer scrutiny is also making it more difficult to ship AI chips to the region...

summary: Some suppliers of Nvidia servers are reportedly suspending shipments to Southeast Asia. The chipmaker's stricter end-customer scrutiny is also making it more difficult to ship AI chips to the region.
